sampling.frame: active pilot commercial references from a versioned source snapshot; not current comparator outputs
sampling.allocation: freeze stratum population counts and quotas before labels; representative sample reports inclusion probabilities and population weights
sampling.rare_strata: report shortages; no duplicate padding, synthetic substitution or retrospective weights
sampling.selection: seeded sampling without replacement from the frozen frame; record selected IDs and algorithm version
sampling.challenge_selection: predeclared confusing families, formats, sweetening and missing/conflicting data; not the population metric
excluded_from_new_confirmatory_counts: copies of the same source file
not_claimed: sampling algorithm for the full frame already implemented

counting.commercial_product_key: store + original product ID, preserved as text
counting.pair_key: unordered pair of distinct cross-store commercial product keys
counting.observation_key: product key + observed source snapshot/version; observations do not inflate unique pair count
counting.query_key: origin observation + requested destination store set + postcode + channel + fixed reference clock
counting.destinations: all three other selected pilot stores, once per query
counting.destination_case_R: query plus one destination store; R is not counted as a separate Q
counting.repeated_CP_or_version: correlated context observations; not new identity evidence
counting.GTIN: preserve raw value and namespace/evidence; no automatic pack identity or independence claim

acquisition.reason_disabled: 2026-09-03 CE-1 SQL reservation is 299920 of 300000 ms; no further remote work today
acquisition.next_window: explicit new reviewed read-only operation after daily budget and target/health/permissions are revalidated; no automatic scheduling
acquisition.pagination: stable keyset with recorded cursors and snapshot/revision coherence; never ORDER BY random() on the full remote catalog
provenance: raw source fields with missing-versus-unselected distinction
capture clock separate from retailer observation clock
location/channel evidence or explicit unverified state
acquisition.missing_data: retain unknowns and conflicts; do not infer false, one unit, stock or local price
